description: The UI tests' item: the fixture photos in ListoraUITests/Fixtures, a shirt whose tag (3-tag.jpg) reads ACME OUTFITTERS, RN 12345, 60% cotton 40% polyester, style AB1234. The brand and color are uncertain, so review lists them first and offers Identify harder; the size is not on the tag. A spoken correction the phone could not parse comes back as the keyword "embroidered logo". A thrift scan of any shot reads the same shirt with a price guess and no sales of the seller's own, so its call rests on the AI estimate; its web research (invented pages) finds a retail range across two models and one Poshmark page, so the call then rests on web info.
